In Sri Lanka, Cemeteries are belongs to Masjids. In recent years, Masjid Administration Boards have contructed shopping complexes to create income for Masjid's maintenance. This is really disturbing me much. If it is not allowed (haram) in Islam, can we pray in these kind of Masjids?, I expect a very very detail response from you. Question: In Shariah, Is it allowed to construct buildings in Muslim Cemeteries? In Sri Lanka, Cemeteries are belongs to Masjids. In recent years, Masjid Administration Boards have contructed shopping complexes to create income for Masjid's maintenance. This is really disturbing me much. If it is not allowed (haram) in Islam, can we pray in these kind of Masjids?, I expect a very very detail response from you. I am collecing opnions and articles from all the sources and going to fight against this issue in Sri Lanka. Please provide very detail reposne based on shariah. Answer ID: 15083 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1370/1387=L=1430) A land should be used in the same purpose for it was endowed; therefore erecting building on Muslim cemetery is not lawful: قال فی الشامی: مراعاۃ غرض الواقفین واجبۃ It was wrong from Masjid administration board to construct shopping complex, but it is allowable to perform salah in the same mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
